ev.q: You need patience with basically everything, especially the bosses
The world, graphics, music, bosses and combat are all so fun and satisfying
the lore is great although it is not very clear to understand
Masterful world design, fair but unforgiving difficulty, environmental storytelling
The way the world is interconnected is really impressive
the world doesn't feel very lived in
Drop in quality in the second half of the game
All that goes out the window when you get the Lords soul about halfway in
up to 6 players with dedicated servers
